bbd.text: In the Qal Sisma mountains, dragons melt the snow and flood the valley, and Naiva and Baishya find the hunting party alive on a hill above the flood, tending the injured.

When Baishya calls her grandmother Yasova Dragonclaw, a name Atarka has banned, she slips into a whisper trance and sees dragons wake from egg-stones, among them the twins Nicol and Ugin, and their sister Merrevia Sal killed by hunters.
Back at the camp, three of Atarka's broodlings demand the clan surrender its shamans, and Yasova lies and distracts them with goblin corpses.
Baishya explains that the vision came from Ugin and they must go to his grave.
